Happy 250th Anniversary, America 🇺🇸❤️

I saw @mayemusk’s post today sharing her family’s American story — how their roots run deep in this country across generations, and how Elon came here as a teenager with the family following soon after. 

It’s a beautiful reminder of the journeys, choices, and resilience that have built this nation.

Whether your family’s American story stretches back centuries or began when someone decided to leave everything behind for opportunity and freedom, that same spirit of putting down roots and building for the next generation is what makes this country extraordinary.

It’s that legacy of grit and forward momentum that continues today — in the way we innovate, the technology we create, and the communities that rally around big ideas right here at home.

Proud to be part of this ongoing American story with all of you in the Tesla community.
Wishing everyone a safe, joyful, and gratitude-filled Independence Day. 

Let’s keep building the future together. 🚀⚡

America's birth rate continues to decline.

The U.S. fertility rate has fallen 23% since 2007, and no state  is now above the replacement level of 2.1 births per woman.

It's a demographic trend that Elon Musk has warned about for years—and one that could have major long-term economic and societal impacts.
